'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
***Acting [[Governor of Kursk Oblast]] [[Alexei Smirnov (politician)|Alexei Smirnov]] accuses the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] of using [[chemical weapons]] that poisoned [[Russia]]n civilians. [[Ukraine]]'s [[Security Service of Ukraine|State Security Service]] denies these claims and accuses Russia of falsifying [[War crimes in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|war crimes]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-says-ukraine-using-chemical-weapons-kursk-1937987 (''Newsweek'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russia-tries-accuse-it-false-war-crimes-kursk-2024-08-12/ (Reuters)]
***Ukrainian colonel general [[Oleksandr Syrskyi]] announces that Ukrainian forces now control over {{conv|1000|km2|mi2|0|abbr=on}} of Russia's [[Kursk region]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-incursion-kursk-afa42b9613323901bef07800ac2cae9e (AP)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russian forces take the settlement of Lysychne in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-evacuates-another-border-region-amid-growing-threat-ukrainian-units-2024-08-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh]]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense]] [[Lloyd Austin]] orders the [[USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)|USS ''Abraham Lincoln'']] [[aircraft carrier]] strike group and the [[USS Georgia (SSGN-729)|USS ''Georgia'']] [[Cruise-missile submarine|SSGN cruise-missile submarine]] to the [[Middle East]] to defend [[Israel]] from possible retaliation from [[Iran]] and to strengthen the [[U.S. military]] position in the region. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/12/us-orders-submarine-to-middle-east-carrier-strike-group-to-sail-faster (Al Jazeera)]
**Hezbollah fires 30 [[Katyusha rocket launcher|Katyusha rockets]] targeting the [[146th Division (Israel)|IDF 146th Division]] headquarters in [[Ga'aton]] and an IDF surveillance station in [[Metula]]. An Israeli [[Iron Dome]] interceptor missile destroys an [[Avdon]] residence. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/12/israels-war-on-gaza-live-1-8-of-enclaves-population-killed-since-oct-7/ (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Third Battle of Khan Yunis]]
***Ten [[Palestinian]]s are killed in an [[IDF|Israeli]] airstrike on a residential home in [[Khan Younis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/10-palestinians-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-on-home-in-khan-younis-southern-gaza-strip/3302133 (Anadolu Ajansı)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[List of landmarks destroyed or damaged by climate change|Damage of landmarks from climate change]]
**The Double Arch, a [[natural arch]] made of 190 million-year-old rock in the [[Glen Canyon National Recreation Area]], collapses, possibly due to changing water levels and [[Erosion|erosion]]. [https://www.npr.org/2024/08/11/nx-s1-5071160/double-arch-collapse-utah-lake-powell-glen-canyon (NPR)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Chevron Corporation]] delivers the first oil from a [[Gulf of Mexico]] [[oil field]], drilled under extreme [[ambient pressure|subsea pressure]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/chevron-delivers-industry-first-ultra-high-pressure-oil-field-2024-08-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*One person is killed and several others are injured when a helicopter stolen from [[Cairns Airport]] crashes into a hotel in [[Cairns]], [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/article/2024/aug/12/helicopter-crashes-into-roof-of-cairns-hotel-in-early-hours-of-morning (''The Guardian'')]
*One person is killed and 132 others are injured after a magnitude 5.0 [[List of earthquakes in the Levant|earthquake]] strikes [[Salamiyah]], [[Homs Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.maspero.eg/arab-and-world/2024/08/13/799115/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-65-%D8%A5%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%88%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%82-%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%A9 (Maspero)] [https://english.enabbaladi.net/archives/2024/08/1-death-and-25-injuries-due-to-earthquake-in-rural-hama/ (Enab Baladi)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
**The [[Council on American–Islamic Relations]] files a lawsuit against the [[United States government]] and the [[FBI]] over alleged [[Anti-Palestinianism|anti-Palestinian discrimination]] against two [[Palestinian Americans]] for placing them on a watch list despite having no violent crime convictions. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/us-government-sued-over-alleged-discrimination-against-palestinian-americans-2024-08-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Pakistan Army]] officials arrest former [[Director-General of Inter-Services Intelligence|Director-General]] of the [[Inter-Services Intelligence]] [[Faiz Hameed]], accusing him of abusing his position of power and raiding a business last year. [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistans-former-spy-chief-detained-by-military/a-69923794 (DW)]
*[[2024 Eskisehir mosque stabbing]]
**A teenager stabs five people at a mosque in [[Eskişehir]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/turkey-teenager-stabbing-mosque/ (CBS News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]], [[Twitter under Elon Musk]]
**Former [[President of the United States|president]] and [[Republican party (United States)|Republican]] presidential candidate [[Donald Trump]] comes back to [[Twitter|X (formerly Twitter)]] for a two-hour interview with its owner [[Elon Musk]], mainly focusing on Trump's [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|2024 presidential re-election campaign]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/elon-musk-interview-trump-x-social-media-network-2024-08-12/ (Reuters)].
*[[Special Region of Jakarta Act]]
**The first [[Cabinet of Indonesia]] meeting session in [[Nusantara (city)|Nusantara]] is held, marking the beginning of the transition of the official [[Capital of Indonesia|capital]] away from [[Jakarta]]. [https://finance.detik.com/infrastruktur/d-7484900/jokowi-gelar-rapat-kabinet-perdana-di-ikn-hari-ini (Detik)]
*[[Iran]]ian [[vice presidents of Iran|Vice President]] [[Mohammad Javad Zarif]] resigns after 11 days in office, citing disappointment with his progress and the new [[Cabinet of Iran|Cabinet]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/irans-vice-president-resigns-after-11-days-in-office/a-69918380 (DW)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Water on Mars]]
**Liquid water is confirmed to be present at depths of {{conv|10|–|20|km|mi|1|abbr=on}} below the surface of [[Mars]], based on a new analysis of data from [[NASA]]'s ''[[InSight]]'' lander. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxl849j77ko (BBC News)]
